channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Cláudio Castro nega recebimento de dinheiro de bicheiro alvo da PF
item.description: The defense of former governor Cláudio Castro denied receiving any payment or illegal donation from bicheiro Adilson Oliveira Coutinho Filho, known as Adilsinho, stating that mere mention in a list does not prove wrongdoing. Castro emphasized that his 2022 campaign was regularly reported and approved by electoral justice, and that he is not a formal target of Operation Unha e Carne. He resigned as Rio governor in March 2026, one day before the TSE ruling on requests for his cassation and eight-year ineligibility.

item.title: Aula magna de Fernando Haddad na Unicamp tem confusão e briga; vídeo
item.description: Fernando Haddad's public lecture at Unicamp on Brazil's economic challenges was disrupted by protesters, leading to physical altercations. Security removed the demonstrators, and Haddad left the venue without speaking to the press. No injuries were reported.

item.title: Lula inaugura pilar de ponte e túnel de transposição sem água
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurated structural works in Bahia and Rio Grande do Norte, including a bridge pier and a water transfer tunnel, as part of an intensified travel agenda in the Northeast before the electoral deadline. The events were marked by public demands and technical setbacks, reflecting pressure to deliver visible results in an election year.

item.title: STF mantém suspensa votação que pode cassar o mandato de Renato Freitas no Paraná
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Luiz Edson Fachin upheld the suspension of a vote that could remove state deputy Renato Freitas (PT) from office, preserving an injunction from the Paraná Court of Justice that halted the ethics proceedings following a physical altercation in November 2025. The Paraná Legislative Assembly plans to bring the case before the full STF, arguing that the individual ministerial decision does not reflect the Court's position.

item.title: À liberdade, portanto!
item.description: The author reflects on freedom as a value built through words, reflection, and overcoming internal and external obstacles. He criticizes the 6×1 work scale as unconstitutional because it prevents the constitutional right to leisure, suggesting it should be challenged in the STF via direct action of unconstitutionality. He also emphasizes the timely importance of dreams and memories as guides to correct past mistakes and live the present with greater awareness.

item.title: Governo não abre mão do PIX, mas apresenta novas medidas aos EUA para evitar tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government presented new measures to the U.S. in a meeting with Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to avoid a 25% additional tariff on Brazilian products, while maintaining its firm stance on PIX. The strategy aims to reinforce the 'status quo' of trade practices deemed non-unfair by Brazil, despite obstacles noted by Minister Marcio Elias Rosa. The deadline for a final decision is July 15, with another meeting scheduled before that date.

item.title: Governo Lula apresenta aos EUA plano de negociação para evitar tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government presented a negotiation plan to the U.S. to avoid a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, proposing tariff cuts on around 300 product lines, particularly in machinery and IT sectors, without harming domestic industry. Delivered by Minister Márcio Elias Rosa to U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, the confidential document aims to address USTR concerns under WTO rules, while excluding topics like Pix and internal Brazilian politics.

item.title: Órgãos do governo criam novos perfis para defeso eleitoral
item.description: The federal government announced the creation of new social media profiles for the Ministry of Justice and the Attorney General's Office to serve the public during the electoral blackout period, which runs from July 4 to October 25, 2026. These profiles will be informational and service-oriented, allowing dissemination of essential services without constituting institutional advertising, in compliance with Brazil's Election Law (Law No. 9,504/1997). Federal service channels will remain open, while promotional materials will be hidden or removed.

item.title: Lula critica Flávio Bolsonaro por pedido de adiamento de tarifas dos EUA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for requesting the United States delay the implementation of 25% tariffs on Brazilian exports, accusing him of disloyalty to the nation and favoring foreign interests during an election year. Lula stated the request, submitted to the USTR, aims to politically strengthen his government and is unacceptable, particularly given the Bolsonaro family’s history of supporting tariffs against Brazilian products.

item.title: Após saída, PL Mulher faz homenagem com imagem de Michelle Bolsonaro de papelão em tamanho real
item.description: PL Women paid tribute to Michelle Bolsonaro with a life-size cardboard cutout after her resignation from the party's women's wing. Her departure followed a dispute with her stepson, Flávio Bolsonaro, who later apologized. The party plans to nominate Michelle for a Senate seat in the Federal District.

item.title: O que Flávio prometeu a Trump caso seja eleito sobre Pix, Mercosul e redes sociais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sent a letter to the U.S. government urging a delay in potential 25% retaliatory tariffs on Brazilian goods until after the October 2026 elections. He pledged, if elected, to appoint a negotiator for good-faith talks with the U.S., avoid linking PIX to non-Western instant payment systems, relieve the credit card sector (benefiting American companies), pursue bilateral trade agreements with the U.S. to reduce Mercosul dependence, and impeach Supreme Court ministers who have ruled against American social media platforms, which he frames as censorship.

item.title: MST pede a Haddad revisão de lei de Tarcísio sobre terras em SP
item.description: MST members met with Fernando Haddad, pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, to challenge the state law on destitution of public lands enacted by Tarcísio de Freitas, currently under review in the Supreme Federal Court for allegedly favoring farmers with up to 90% discounts on vacant public lands. The movement presented six proposals, including allocating 500,000 hectares in Pontal do Paranapanema for agroforestry and agroecological settlements, financing for family farming agroindustries, reform of agricultural credit via FEAP, construction of subsidized fruit and vegetable markets in peripheries, a cooperativism department, and a reforestation plan. Haddad requested a detailed document of the proposals for future evaluation.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula entrega ônibus escolares e unidades móveis de saúde no CE
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva participated in the delivery of 40 school buses and mobile health units in Juazeiro do Norte, Ceará, as part of the Novo PAC. The investment totals R$18 million for the buses, which will benefit approximately 1,975 students per trip, especially in rural areas. Additionally, 29 mobile dental units and 19 vehicles from the Caminhos da Saúde program were delivered to transport SUS patients for consultations, exams, and treatments.

item.title: Quem é Aroldo Medina, pré-candidato a vice-presidente na chapa de Renan Santos
item.description: Aroldo Medina, a military police reservist and animal rights advocate, has been announced as the pre-candidate for vice president on Renan Santos' (Missão) ticket for the October 2026 elections. He is known for his social media activism and criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cita o Master em carta a Trump, mas omite relação com o ‘irmão’ Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro sent a letter to the USTR requesting a 180-day suspension of a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, claiming it would benefit Lula in the 2026 elections. In the letter, he references the Banco Master scandal, alleging ties between the bank’s owner and government corruption, as well as links to organized crime and foreign terrorist organizations — but omits his personal relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, the bank’s owner, whom he has called 'brother' in private messages. The omission is notable given that Flávio had directly negotiated a R$ 134 million loan from Vorcaro for the propaganda film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: “Lula defende o Brasil, Flávio entrega depois”, diz Lindbergh
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for submitting a mandatory statement to the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) urging the suspension of new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, claiming the move would benefit certain interests. Lindbergh argued that while Lula defends Brazil nationally, Flávio is acting under external pressure, delivering concessions afterward that should have been protected. The senator’s stance was seen as submissive to U.S. interests, contrasting with the federal government’s defense of national sovereignty.

item.title: Flávio associa caso do PCC ao governo Lula e mira Lulinha em vídeo nas redes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, posted a video on social media linking PCC money laundering investigations to the Lula government and claiming the Executive 'is always on the wrong side of history'. The video also targeted Lulinha, the president's son, as part of the criticism.

item.title: Após ganhar seguidores com vídeo sobre Flávio, Michelle sofre reação nas redes
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro gained nearly 100,000 followers after posting a video exposing her rift with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, breaking a 20-day decline in support. However, in the five days that followed, she lost 10,121 followers and faced a wave of criticism, 83% of which came from male profiles. Despite the recent loss, she maintains a high engagement rate of 5.4%, indicating strong influence over her base amid the intensifying narrative battle.

item.title: Flávio diz que tarifaço beneficia Lula e sugere decisão definitiva após eleições
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged the U.S. USTR to delay the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian exports until after the 2026 elections, claiming it would politically reward President Lula’s strategy of provoking trade conflicts with the U.S. to gain domestic electoral advantage. He argues that Lula is deliberately escalating tensions to turn U.S. retaliation into a political asset, citing Lula’s public criticism of Trump, refusal to engage with the USTR, and issuance of debt in Chinese yuan as evidence of this tactic.

item.title: STM deve julgar a perda de patente de Bolsonaro após as eleições
item.description: The Superior Military Tribunal (STM) is expected to rule on the possible loss of rank and patent of former President Jair Bolsonaro only after the second round of the 2026 elections, due to judicial recess, the volume of the case, and concerns about politicization during the campaign. The ruling follows a determination by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, based on the Federal Constitution, to assess whether military officials sentenced to more than two years in initial closed regime remain worthy of officership. In addition to Bolsonaro, Admiral Almir Garnier and Generals Paulo Sérgio Nogueira, Augusto Heleno, and Walter Braga Netto will be tried separately for their roles in the January 8, 2023 coup attempt.

item.title: Celina Leão diz que saída de Michelle do PL foi “descartada”
item.description: District of Federal Governor Celina Leão stated that Michelle Bolsonaro's departure from the PL has been ruled out, despite her resignation from PL Women's presidency following a public dispute with Flávio Bolsonaro. Celina emphasized that Michelle's decision was driven by personal and health reasons, not political estrangement from the party. She affirmed Michelle retains significant influence, particularly among female voters.

item.title: Em meio a desgaste de Flavio com público feminino, Lula fala em 'aumentar a pena para quem mata mulher'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced plans to increase penalties for men who kill women, advocating for stricter laws against femicide during events in Rio Grande do Norte and Ceará. He linked the initiative to the declining support for his main rival, Flavio Bolsonaro, among female voters amid public family disputes and controversial remarks by allies. Lula also urged women to pursue education as a path to financial independence and autonomy from men.

item.title: Petistas chamam Michelle de “funcionária do mês” após atrito com Flávio
item.description: PT militants created a card mocking Michelle Bolsonaro as 'employee of the month' following her public dispute with Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president. The controversy arose after Michelle accused Flávio of humiliating her in a phone call, tied to disagreements over PL alliances in Ceará. Although the image is satirical, PT leaders avoid direct comment, instead focusing on linking Flávio to the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: STF e PF avançam em investigações sobre possíveis irregularidades do filme 'Dark Horse'
item.description: The STF and the PF are advancing investigations into potential irregularities in the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the political trajectory of former president Jair Bolsonaro. The proceedings involve the analysis of public or private funds used in the documentary's production, suspected of violating electoral legislation and constituting abuse of economic power. The inquiry aims to clarify whether there was illicit funding linked to campaigns or governmental acts.

item.title: Lula defende Mercosul após crítica de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended Mercosul as Brazil's essential economic bloc after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sent a document to the U.S. advocating for flexibilizing Mercosul rules to allow bilateral agreements with the United States. Lula accused the Bolsonaro family of deliverism and stated Brazil will continue to dialogue on equal terms with all nations, rejecting any justification for U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula inaugura pilar de ponte e túnel sem água
item.description: President Lula inaugurated the pillar of a bridge and a tunnel intended to carry water from the São Francisco River to Rio Grande do Norte, though the projects remain incomplete and no water is flowing. The ceremony took place before the July 4 electoral deadline, complying with laws that prohibit inaugurations after that date. The move was criticized as symbolic and desperate, aiming to secure political visibility ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Imunizar a ciência
item.description: Nísia Trindade, former Health Minister and Fiocruz president, launched her book 'Still Time' to recount the fight against scientific denialism during the pandemic. She emphasizes the use of the Legal Framework for ST&I to incorporate the Oxford vaccine into SUS, produced at Bio-Manguinhos, and warns Brazil cannot afford to flirt with obscurantism again. Trindade is a pre-candidate for federal deputy from the PT in Rio de Janeiro in the 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE de um homem só
item.description: The article examines the concentration of power in Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) under the influence of a single individual, raising concerns about the independence of electoral justice. Marjorie Marona, professor of Political Science at UNIRIO and researcher at QualiGov, analyzes how this centralization may undermine the legitimacy of the 2026 elections and the rule of law in Brazil.

item.title: Os afetos que nos separam
item.description: Jairo Nicolau's book 'O País Dividido' analyzes the evolution of the Brazilian electorate between 2002 and 2026, highlighting aging, increased female participation, and rising education levels as key factors transforming electoral behavior. By combining political science, sociology, and demography, the author explains how these structural changes, alongside impactful political events, have produced a more distinct and politically transformed electorate, particularly in second-round presidential runoffs.

item.title: CARTUM: 1420
item.description: The article warns that, on the eve of the 2026 elections, Brazil's democratic future is again at stake, as the Bolsonarist threat has only retreated, not been defeated. It emphasizes the continued influence of conservative forces in Congress and global instability worsened by conflicts in Gaza, Iran, and Ukraine, alongside the international rise of the far-right. It calls on readers who value critical journalism to subscribe or contribute to CartaCapital to support democratic defense.

item.title: Lula: Nordeste sempre foi tratado com muito desprezo pelas pessoas que governaram este País
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated during an event in his Northeastern electoral base that the region has historically been treated with 'great contempt' by previous governments. He emphasized that inclusion and development policies are needed to correct this regional inequality. The speech reinforces his electoral mobilization strategy in the Northeast, a key region for his 2022 victories and likely target in 2026.

item.title: Soberania/ Proposta indecorosa
item.description: The PT filed two legal actions against Flávio Bolsonaro and the PL, claiming his correspondence with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio breaches Brazilian sovereignty by offering access to a putative 'transition team' in exchange for easing trade sanctions. The complaint alleges the act may constitute passive corruption, breach of official secrecy, and an affront to national independence. The move follows backlash over U.S. tariffs and aims to investigate potential collusion between the Bolsonaro-aligned pre-candidate and foreign officials.

item.title: Pacote de bondades
item.description: Lula intensifies announcements of infrastructure projects and social programs in the final days before the official campaign period begins, aiming to improve his image amid unfavorable polls. He combines bureaucratic duties with political-party activities, including meetings with allies and recording support videos, while operating in a media landscape dominated by the far-right and facing an opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, embroiled in recent controversies.

item.title: Lula critica família Bolsonaro por “entreguismo” aos EUA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the Bolsonaro family for acting against Brazil's interests by seeking to delay U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, calling it 'entreguismo' and an act of 'traitors of the homeland'. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a PL pre-candidate, filed a document with the USTR claiming the tariffs would politically benefit Lula's government and announced his participation in a U.S. public hearing to defend Brazilian companies.

item.title: Lula reage à carta de Flávio sobre tarifaço dos EUA: ‘É inaceitável o entreguismo’
item.description: President Lula criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's letter to the U.S. government, accusing the Bolsonaro family of 'entreguismo' for seeking to delay the 25% tariff on Brazilian goods. He said the tariff issue has been politicized by his administration to label opposition as traitors, and stressed that Brazil’s sovereignty, Mercosul, and the Pix payment system are non-negotiable.

item.title: Flávio aposta na polarização para minimizar estragos causados por Michelle, que não deve dar trégua
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is banking on polarization with Lula to mitigate the damage caused by Michelle Bolsonaro's controversial statements, which have stirred unrest within the bolsonarist base. Despite the setbacks, allies claim internal and external polls (BTG/Nexus and AtlasIntel/Bloomberg) show stabilized voter intentions, and that Michelle’s influence is confined to a specific niche, particularly among evangelical women, whose support is key to expanding his base.

item.title: Lula reage a documento enviado por Flavio Bolsonaro ao USTR: 'Entreguismo"
item.description: President Lula criticized the document sent by Flávio Bolsonaro to the USTR, calling the Bolsonaro family's action 'surrenderism' for seeking to submit Brazil to U.S. interests. He said it is unacceptable that the Bolsonaro family would use proposed tariffs on Brazilian products to gain political advantage. Flávio Bolsonaro, confirmed for a USTR hearing, argued that the tariff would give Lula exactly the political victory he seeks.

item.title: Lula chama Flávio de traidor da pátria após rival sugerir a Trump decisão sobre tarifaço depois da eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) called federal deputy Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) a 'traitor of the homeland' after he sent a document to the U.S. government urging the postponement of tariffs on Brazilian imports until after the 2026 elections and advocating for the 'liberation' of Mercosur. Lula stated that such actions harm national interests and aim to benefit opposition candidates. The document's content was reported by the press on February 7, 2026.

item.title: Após documento de Flávio sobre tarifaço, Lula critica família Bolsonaro: ‘Traidores da pátria’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva strongly criticized the Bolsonaro family for sending a document to the U.S. government requesting a delay on potential tariffs against Brazilian products, calling the move 'treasonous' and 'surrenderist'. Lula claimed the family’s initiative aims to submit Brazil to foreign interests for their own electoral gain, while his administration works to avoid up to 25% tariffs before the July 15 deadline set by the Trump administration.

item.title: Lula critica pedido de Flávio e atribui à família Bolsonaro possível novo tarifaço dos EUA contra Brasil: 'Traidores da pátria'
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's request to delay U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, calling the Bolsonaro family 'traitors of the homeland' for allegedly pushing for tariff increases to undermine him politically. He rejected any justification for new taxes on Brazilian exports, before or after the elections, and linked the move to the USTR's Section 301 investigation into digital trade, corruption, and deforestation.

item.title: Lula rebate Flávio sobre tarifaço e diz que família Bolsonaro age com ‘entreguismo’: ‘Traidores da pátria’
item.description: Lula accused the Bolsonaro family of treachery, claiming Flávio Bolsonaro urged the U.S. government to delay proposed tariffs on Brazilian goods until after the 2026 elections, calling it an act of 'traitors of the Fatherland'. He stated there is no justification for the tariffs and reaffirmed Brazil's commitment to equal dialogue with all nations.

item.title: Em meio à crise de Flávio com o PL Mulher, Lula aposta em discurso às mulheres
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva delivered a speech targeting women at an official event, emphasizing education, financial independence, and the fight against gender-based violence. The remarks came amid growing weariness among female voters toward Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), due to controversies surrounding the PL Mulher. Lula seeks to capitalize on this dynamic to strengthen his appeal among women.

item.title: Governo Lula atribui impasses com EUA a “atropelos” de terceiros
item.description: Minister of Development Márcio Elias Rosa blamed the stalemate in Brazil-U.S. trade negotiations over the 'tariff hike' on 'missteps' by third parties. He said President Lula’s directive is for the government to never walk away from the negotiating table, maintaining dialogue despite the obstacles.

item.title: Flávio cita Master, mas esconde o vínculo com Vorcaro em pedido de suspensão de tarifas aos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) submitted a document to the U.S. Trade Representative requesting the suspension of proposed 25% tariffs on Brazil, arguing the measure unfairly targets the country due to political persecution of his father, Jair Bolsonaro. In the document, he cited the Banco Master scandal as evidence of Lula government corruption but concealed his own financial ties to Daniel Vorcaro, the bank’s owner, who paid him R$ 134 million to finance a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Após saída de Michelle, PL Mulher faz homenagem com boneca de papelão em tamanho real: 'Líder de Verdade'
item.description: PL Women posted on Instagram a photo of a life-sized cardboard cutout of Michelle Bolsonaro, honoring her as a 'True Leader' after her resignation from the party's women's wing presidency. Michelle stepped down to focus on caring for Jair Bolsonaro and their daughter, following tensions with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, whom she accused of treating her harshly and excluding her from party decisions. PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto mediated the meeting and acknowledged she may also withdraw from the Senate race in the Federal District.

item.title: Deputado diz que quadros e móveis "sumiram" de palácio no governo Zema
item.description: State Deputy Leleco Pimentel (PT) reported the disappearance of assets from the Palácio das Mangabeiras, including over 40 paintings, furniture, and utensils acquired by Juscelino Kubitschek, and filed a representation with the TCE-MG, claiming the items were removed since 2021 during Governor Romeu Zema's (Novo) administration, which converted the palace into a private exhibition center. He blamed current Governor Mateus Simões (PSD), then chief of staff, for neglecting the patrimony and announced he will also file a crime report with the MP. The inspection followed the Secretary of Culture's statement that part of the collection was found damaged in the possession of the Military Police.

item.title: Tarcísio fala em "preocupação" com falhas e insegurança no metrô
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas expressed 'great concern' over failures and insecurity in São Paulo's metro system, emphasizing efforts to improve safety through station integration with the Muralha Paulista program and facial recognition camera deployment. He also noted ongoing interventions, including the replacement of the CPTM communication system, to reduce train intervals and modernize operations.

item.title: STF e PF avançam em investigações sobre possíveis irregularidades do filme ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: The STF and PF are advancing investigations into alleged irregularities in the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays Jair Bolsonaro's political career. Minister André Mendonça requested the PGR to opine on a crime report alleging that film funds were used to finance Eduardo Bolsonaro's stay in the U.S., while the PF investiges whether parliamentary amendments were directed to entities linked to the film's production. The cases involve Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, and Karina Ferreira da Gama, with ties to transactions involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and amendments by Mário Frias.

item.title: Garotinho diz que Flávio não está em vídeo da “Noite das Astronautas”
item.description: Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) does not appear in the 12-minute video of the 'Night of the Astronauts,' a party allegedly organized by Daniel Vorcaro, despite Michelle Bolsonaro sharing his comments about the event. He said the video shows authorities such as deputies, senators, and governors, as well as nude women wearing astronaut helmets, but denied seeing Flávio Bolsonaro in it. Garotinho also said he will not disclose names while the video remains under the custody of the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Flávio reforça núcleo econômico e aproxima ex-secretária de Caiado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro met with former Goiás Secretary of Economy Cristiane Schmidt to strengthen his economic team ahead of the 2026 presidential race. The meeting in Brasília is part of his campaign team-building efforts. Engaging figures associated with Ronaldo Caiado’s administration indicates a strategy to broaden support in the Central-West region.
